calls.statement:
SELECT store_id, store_name, store_key
FROM dim_store
WHERE store_name LIKE '%Nokia%' AND is_current = true

SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_period = 5
ORDER BY fiscal_year

SELECT 
    p.subcategory,
    SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.store_key = 24
    AND f.sale_date >= '2026-08-31'
    AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY p.subcategory
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3

Indoor Lighting | 152
Storage Boxes | 139
(3 rows)

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_lines, SUM(quantity) as total_units
FROM fact_sales_line f
WHERE f.store_key = 24
    AND f.sale_date >= '2026-08-31'
    AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'

SELECT 
    p.subcategory,
    COUNT(*) as line_count,
    SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_key) as product_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.store_key = 24
    AND f.sale_date >= '2026-08-31'
    AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY p.subcategory
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 5

calls.statement:
SELECT 
    p.subcategory,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_line_id IS NULL THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) as net_units,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) as units_returned
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    AND r.return_date >= '2026-08-31'
    AND r.return_date <= '2026-09-27'
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.store_key = 24
    AND f.sale_date >= '2026-08-31'
    AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY p.subcategory
ORDER BY net_units DESC
LIMIT 3
calls.output_preview:

Indoor Lighting | 147 | 5
